Ezekiel 15 · The Vine Tree Given for the Fire

points: The word of the Most High came to Ezekiel asking what the vine tree is more than any other tree, or than a branch among the trees of the forest.

note.label: Ezekiel 15: The Vine Tree Given for the Fire

points: No wood is taken of it to do any work, nor will men take a pin of it to hang a vessel upon; it is cast into the fire for fuel, and the fire devours both ends and the midst of it.

note.label: Ezekiel 15: The Vine Tree Given for the Fire

points: If it was fit for no work when it was whole, how much less is it fit for any work when the fire has devoured it and it is burned.

note.label: Ezekiel 15: The Vine Tree Given for the Fire

points: As the vine tree among the trees of the forest is given to the fire for fuel, so the Most High gives the inhabitants of Jerusalem; they go out from one fire and another fire devours them.

note.label: Ezekiel 15: The Vine Tree Given for the Fire

points: The Most High sets His face against them and makes the land desolate because they have committed a trespass, and they shall know that He is the Lord.
